name: Cod, Chickpea, Tomato & Fennel Stew with Toasted Sourdough

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 fennel bulbs
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root ends and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are starting to soften 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander.

When the veggies have started to soften, add chickpeas, broth, and tomatoes to the pot, then stir to combine the stew. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until veggies and chickpeas are tender, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: While the stew is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add cod to the stew. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cod is opaque and cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide stew between bowls and serve with toast on the side. Enjoy!
